answer: Make every identity post a forfeitable bond that doubles for each identity funded from the same source, so a farm's cost grows exponentially instead of in parallel. Like a plume spreading through an ocean, one fake identity is cheap, but the tenth costs 512 bonds; a ferrous anchor of real stake pins each agent to one wallet history, and the bond is burned if the identity misbehaves. One extra identity costs one more doubled bond plus a fresh attested history, so farming thousands of fake agents becomes ruinously expensive.
